title: ReCache: Efficient KV Cache Reuse and Compression for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.19662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic language models repeatedly encode tool and skill schemas that recur across requests in different combinations and orders, preventing standard prefix caching from reusing their key--value (KV) states. We introduce \textbf{ReCache}, a framework for independently caching resource representations while reducing their inference-time computational and memory overhead. Resource-wise attention removes cross-resource interactions and assigns resource-local positions, producing composition-invariant KV blocks. ReCache then restricts resource visibility to contribution-selected layer--KV-head-group routes and retains only invocation-critical fields through structural and semantic pruning. We evaluate ReCache on a benchmark assembled from seven public tool- and skill-use datasets, including resource-disjoint tests. translated_title: ReCache：面向工具增强型LLM智能体的高效KV缓存复用与压缩
translated_abstract: 智能体语言模型会反复编码在请求中以不同组合和顺序出现的工具与技能模式，这阻碍了标准前缀缓存对其键值（KV）状态的复用。我们提出了ReCache框架，该框架独立缓存资源表示，同时降低其推理时的计算和内存开销。资源级注意力机制消除了跨资源交互，并为资源分配局部位置，从而生成与组合无关的KV块。随后，ReCache将资源可见性限制在基于贡献选择的层-KV头组路径上，并通过结构和语义剪枝仅保留对调用关键字段。我们在由七个公开工具和技能使用数据集（包括资源不相交测试）组成的基准上评估了ReCache。资源级注意力在匹配密集调用性能（82.3%对82.4%的Inv-F1）的同时，提供了3.655倍的加速时间。
tldr: ReCache通过资源级注意力机制和选择性剪枝实现独立缓存复用，在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理开销。
en_tdlr: ReCache enables independent cache reuse via resource-wise attention and selective pruning, significantly reducing inference overhead while maintaining performance.
